1:name: Reusable — backend CI (build + test + coverage)
3:# CI-only backend build for PR / main / workflow_dispatch. No versioning, no publish,
60:      # of runs while `build` runs on ~42%, so it is the most-executed job in the pipeline.
76:  build:
81:      # Only supersede pull-request runs. Cancelling a push build kills it before
82:      # actions/cache's post step, so the Gradle cache never saves — and the NEXT build
84:      # over 10 backend builds: the 7 with an intact predecessor averaged 401s against a
85:      # 723s no-cache baseline (-44%), while all 3 that followed a cancelled build came
106:        id: set-gradle-params
114:      # setup-gradle's own caching is disabled deliberately. Its bundled cache client
118:      # was ever stored in either GitHub's cache or the S3 bucket, so every backend build
123:      # avoids bumping setup-gradle three majors: its v6 moved caching into a proprietary
125:      # configuration-cache support this build relies on.
127:        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3
131:      # Keyed on the version catalog, the wrapper and every build script, then on run_id.
137:      # ACCUMULATING cache — its value is the Gradle build-cache entries that build up in
138:      # ~/.gradle/caches/build-cache-1 over successive runs.
145:      # Do not "simplify" this back to a static key: it would silently stop the build cache
146:      # from ever growing. Safe to save because every gradlew invocation runs --no-daemon,
152:            ~/.gradle/caches
153:            ~/.gradle/wrapper
154:          key: gradle-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}/gradle/libs.versions.toml', inputs.working-directory), format('{0}/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', inputs.working-directory), format('{0}/**/*.gradle.kts', inputs.working-directory)) }}-${{ github.run_id }}
156:            gradle-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles(format('{0}/gradle/libs.versions.toml', inputs.working-directory), format('{0}/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', inputs.working-directory), format('{0}/**/*.gradle.kts', inputs.working-directory)) }}-
157:            gradle-${{ runner.os }}-
159:      # ktlint and detekt run as part of `build` and both fail it on a finding
160:      # (urbo-build 1.0.52 / 1.0.56). koverXmlReport produces the JaCoCo-format coverage
161:      # XML consumed by the PR coverage comment below. No bootJar/publish here — the
162:      # tagged release build does that.
165:          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SWCODE_PACKAGES_READER }}
166:        run: ./gradlew build koverXmlReport --no-daemon --configuration-cache ${{ env.PULL_REQUEST_GRADLE_PARAMS }}
